purpose: Single targeted A/B for Order 123 hypothesis 1: expose a reusable VLC operation that extracts an embedded subtitle stream to a model-selected SRT or VTT path.
change_scope: Add generic vlc.media.extract_subtitles with model-selected input_path, output_path, and optional zero-based subtitle_stream_index. The Adapter validates SRT/VTT output format, probes embedded subtitle streams, executes fixed-argument ffmpeg without a shell, writes atomically, and verifies UTF-8 timed cues, size, and SHA-256. LiteAgent adds semantic catalog keywords and a direct typed schema. No task identity, fixed path, subtitle content, answer, golden material, evaluator state, instruction parser, argument injection, or workflow is embedded.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this single Order 123 targeted A/B, mark the task task_blocked, and immediately continue in source order. Do not add another Order-123-local schema, prompt, facade, or unchanged retry. A proven transient Runner or environment fault may be retried at most twice.

implementation_evidence.failure_evidence: The untouched v129 baseline returned evaluator 0.0 after 22 steps. Qwen repeatedly searched for VLC subtitle extraction/export, then invented VLC document.open; no Adapter action executed and the eight-event guard stopped the episode.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_tests: Unit tests use unrelated MKV, WebM, MOV, SRT, and VTT names, different subtitle text, two embedded stream indexes, both supported formats, absent-stream and out-of-range errors, and independent digest/cue verification. No Order 123 path or expected subtitle content appears in runtime code or tests.
implementation_evidence.clean_guest_integration: A temporary clean Docker/KVM guest embedded a synthetic subtitle into MP4, deployed the production VLC Adapter, extracted SRT through real ffprobe/ffmpeg, and passed Adapter verification; the integration test passed 1/1 and the container was removed.
implementation_evidence.static_verification: Ruff, compileall, project layout/deployment leakage, frozen-v1 SHA256SUMS, frozen OSWorld commit, and evaluator-tree checks passed.

selection.method: single targeted A/B for the preserved Order 123 v129 missing-capability failure
